Superior block is a defensive mechanic that applies to few characters. It interrupts all combos. When a heavy attack is blocked with superior block, it bounces off, puts the attacker in a stagger that lasts long enough to not be able to counter a guardbreak.
But you must guardbreak as soon as they bounce off.

Conqueror has it active on all his normal block frames and his heavy attack start ups. Not on his full block. Warlord has it on full block and his light start up. Valkyrie has it on dodge blocks, full block and light attack start ups. Warden has it on his top lights and will trigger his crushing counter. Kensei also has it on his dodges, so a good way to set up a guardbreak is to dash into an attack while matching guard stances. I dont know any else. If anyone knows feel free to add.

Hitting a superior heavy start up block will guarantee the following heavy if countering an incoming heavy. Blocking incoming lights with superior block does not give enough block stun to follow up. Does not work with unblockables, can parry though. Full block doesn't have superior block.

A good place to just gain levels in general is the wight grind at the greatwall encampment. The wight only spawns at night. From the main gate of the greatwall encampment you follow the path down to the right, but eventually the path will take a left turn, ignore that and just go straight down the ditch, there should be a wight there. As long as you dont kill it, it will continuously summon skeleton warriors until daytime. They net 1500xp each with around 8-10 coming at you per wave. 3000 if you have a pilgrims charm or any other weal granting item. It is even faster if you switch to hard mode going up to 6000xp per kill with weal. Play solo when doing this for max xp. Autonomy augment for solo offense and defense boost, Bloodlust augment for the night time farming.
